description: This file contains unit tests for the PatientDAO, specifically testing various search and retrieval functionalities of patient data within the OpenMRS system. It ensures correct behavior for search modes, filtering, name/identifier matching, and exclusion of voided data.

classes.name: PatientDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PatientDAO methods, including patient search, retrieval, filtering, and handling of voided data. Uses the BaseContextSensitiveTest for database setup.

methods.description: Setup method to load test data and initialize helpers before each test.
